# Summary

Reworked the overlay key map: retired digits as labels, made
`,./;'[]\` typeable labels, moved the displaced hotkeys onto digits, added `1`
as a close alias, and made closing the overlay menu-safe. Plan:
[`20260729-174111_keybinding-rework.plan.qmd`](20260729-174111_keybinding-rework.plan.qmd).

# New key map

| Key | Action | Was |
|---|---|---|
| `Esc`, `1` | close (menu-safe) | Esc only |
| `2` | suspend | `\` |
| `3` | cycle grid layout (Grid+GridLayouts) | `;` |
| backtick | dim | unchanged |
| `A–Z` | label chars (always) | unchanged |
| `, . / ; ' [ ] \` | label chars (when in `HintCharacters`) | passthrough / hotkey |
| `4`–`0` | passthrough | label chars |

# What changed

- `Services/OverlayKeyboardHook.cs`: `Classify` gains a `labelChars` param
  (uppercased `HintCharacters`). New digit block — `VK_1`→Escape,
  `VK_2`→SuspendNow, `VK_3`→CycleLayout (when capable); the old `VK_0..VK_9`
  AppendChar range and the `;`/`\` action lines are gone. New `LabelCharForVk`
  (letters always; OEM only when in `labelChars`) + `OemCharForVk` (US-layout).
  `KeyboardProc` reads `HintCharacters` per keydown via
  `OverlayActionConfig.ReadRawString` and passes it in.
- `NativeMethods/User32.cs`: `VK_1/2/3`, `VK_OEM_2/4/6/7/_COMMA/_PERIOD`,
  `WS_EX_NOACTIVATE`.
- `Views/OverlayView.xaml.cs`: `SetClickThrough` now also ORs `WS_EX_NOACTIVATE`
  onto the overlay HWND (menu-safe close).
- `App.config`: `HintCharacters` default → `A–Z` + `,./;'[]\` (no digits).
- `OverlayKeyboardHookTest.cs`: rewritten for the new map (letters, digit
  functions, punctuation-as-label, `\`/`;` as labels, `3` cycle).
- `CLAUDE.md`: runtime-behavior spec updated.

# Menu-safe close (hypothesis — needs Windows verification)

The close path (`App.xaml.cs:72-78`) does no foreground manipulation and Esc is
already swallowed by the hook, so the dismissal most likely came from the overlay
acquiring foreground and returning it on close. `WS_EX_NOACTIVATE` makes the
window never enter the activation chain, so closing it should cause no foreground
transition and the context menu beneath keeps activation. **Not reproducible on
Linux** — flagged for manual test. Fallback if it does not hold: switch Esc/`1`
to a suspend-style hide.
